invariants.title: He is small and far
invariants.rule: A wide shot: the whole aisle between the camera and him.
invariants.why: The distance is the threat - he has all of it to cross.

invariants.title: One step, then he stops
invariants.rule: He takes a single step out of the rain and stops, looking down the aisle.
invariants.why: Our engines hold the walker, not the walk; one step is what they do well. The walk is Seedance's (see its tab).

invariants.title: It is LTX
invariants.rule: The take in the film is LTX-2.5's.
invariants.why: The rain blowing in around him is LTX's.

flair.title: Camera
flair.note: a slow push of about a fifth; still reads as held

title: the door
beat: Hale in the doorway at the far end of the aisle, small against the rain. He lets go of the frame and takes one step in.

build.script: LTX-2.5 (70) from a Qwen-Image-2.1 start frame (qwen21_s11) · take 11
